post.summary: Create or find a direct-message conversation

get.summary: Resolve effective Unit access for the current Profile

post.summary: Restrict subject access to a Unit scope

put.description: Assigns or renames a Zone's optional public slug in the permanent zones namespace. The former address is retained as a redirect.

put.summary: Create or replace a Unit Dock

get.summary: List Units followed by the current user
Get current user's follow state for a Unit

post.summary: Resolve a complete public Unit slug path
post.description: Resolves one to three slug labels to a public Unit ID and reports its canonical path. Browser routes use the resolved ID for subsequent resource reads and cache identity.

get.summary: Get a Unit public canonical slug address
get.description: Returns a public Unit's optional canonical slug address for ID-route canonicalization. Missing, private, moderated, deleted, or unaddressed Units all return not found.

get.summary: Resolve a Unit slug in its direct scope
get.description: Resolves a direct scope Unit ID and slug label to a public Unit ID. An optional expected kind prevents cross-resource matches. The response includes the complete canonical path so callers can redirect former addresses.

put.summary: Replace the current Profile slug address
put.description: Sets or replaces the authenticated Profile's optional slug label. The server always uses the permanent users namespace; callers cannot choose a scope. Repeating the same replacement is idempotent.

get.summary: Get a Unit canonical slug address as staff
get.description: Returns canonical address registry details for staff workflows, including the administrative address ID. Ordinary resource responses expose only the nullable public slugAddress projection.

put.summary: Replace any Unit slug address as staff
put.description: Assigns or replaces a canonical address independently of Unit creation and update. It retains the former address as a redirect and succeeds idempotently when the requested address is already canonical.

post.summary: Create an explicitly addressed namespace as staff
post.description: Creates a namespace Unit and its canonical address atomically. A null scope creates a top-level namespace under the virtual root; a Unit ID creates a nested namespace.

delete.summary: Release an administrative slug redirect as staff
delete.description: Deletes one non-public administrative redirect so the scope and label may be reused. Redirects in enabled public route namespaces are permanent and cannot be released.

patch.summary: Move or rename Content Structure node

put.description: Assigns or renames a Realm's optional public slug in the permanent realms namespace. The former address is retained as a redirect.

post.summary: Execute a trusted Zone Dock Search Block
Execute a trusted Zone Page Search Block
